reason: We already get renders and plans through the architect or our in-house people, and I'm in my truck between lots most days. I'm not adding a vendor and a per-home fee when the homeowner would have to agree to pay it anyway.
objection: With a library of 50-plus plans, $1,500 a home adds up fast and I can't charge the buyer for it. The architect already covers this, so I'd be paying twice.
would_change_my_mind: A flat price for my whole plan library, or proof that it closes spec home sales faster and the buyer pays for it, not me.
